snippet.title: BLACKSHARD - Teaser
snippet.description:
BLACKSHARD is a visual & narrative experience, a dreamlike journey into uncharted liminal spaces.

Wander through strange places, endless corridors and unreal architectures, meet mysterious characters that have been forgotten for ages...

Are you ready to enter the labyrinth?
